h1: Custom Orange Jackets for Your Team
metaDescription: Order custom orange jackets for your team. High-visibility options for safety, plus fleece and packable styles. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Orange jackets are a practical choice for teams that need high visibility on job sites or during outdoor events. From ANSI-rated safety vests to insulated fleece jackets like the Men's Rixford Polyfleece, orange helps your crew stand out while staying warm. Whether you need custom embroidery for a corporate look or screen printing for a promotional giveaway, orange jackets offer versatility and safety in one package.
heroAltText: Custom orange jackets for teams, including high-visibility safety jackets and insulated fleece styles
